description: Schema for extracting property listings from real estate listing/search/browse pages. Each record represents one property card as shown on the listing page.

address.description: Full or partial address of the property as shown on the listing card.
address.normalization: Preserve the address as shown. Do not geocode.

listing_title.description: Title or headline of the listing card (e.g. '3-bed house in Dublin').

property_type.description: Type of property (e.g. 'Apartment', 'House', 'Studio', 'Villa'). Retain the site's original label.

price.description: Asking price. Structured as {amount, currency_code, currency_symbol, period} where period applies to rental listings (e.g. 'month'). For sale prices, period is null.
price.normalization: Extract numerical amount, ISO 4217 currency code, and symbol. For rental, capture the billing period.

bathrooms.description: Number of bathrooms (may be fractional, e.g. 1.5).

floor_area.description: Floor/living area. Structured as {value, unit} where unit is 'm2', 'ft2', or 'sqm'.
floor_area.normalization: Preserve original unit. Do not convert between units unless explicitly requested.

rooms.description: Total number of rooms (used on French and Moroccan sites where rooms ≠ bedrooms).

price_per_m2.description: Price per square metre. Structured as {amount, currency_code, currency_symbol}.

monthly_fees.description: Monthly co-op/HOA/maintenance fees. Structured as {amount, currency_code}.

total_price.description: Total price including debt/fees (Finn Eiendom: asking price + joint debt). Structured as {amount, currency_code}.

published_date.description: Date the listing was published. Normalize to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).
published_date.normalization: Convert to YYYY-MM-DD. Resolve relative dates (e.g. 'Added 3 days ago') using the snapshot date.

open_house_schedule.description: Scheduled open house dates/times (e.g. [{date, time_start, time_end}]).

key_features.description: Short feature bullet points shown on the listing card.

description.description: Short description or teaser text shown on the listing card.

additional_facilities.description: Additional facilities shown on the listing card (Leboncoin-specific).

images_urls.description: List of property image URLs from the listing card.

listing_agent.description: Agent or brokerage info as shown on the card. May include name, phone, and/or photo.

listing_agent_photo.description: URL of the agent's profile photo.

listing_office.description: Name of the listing agency or office.

normalization_rules.price: Extract numerical amount without currency symbols. Identify currency by ISO 4217 code. For rentals, capture the period (month/week).
normalization_rules.floor_area: Preserve the original value and unit (m2, ft2). Do not convert between units.
normalization_rules.published_date: Convert to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Resolve relative dates using the snapshot date.
normalization_rules.images_urls: Return a list of full absolute image URLs.

notes: The 'listing_title' field is absent on many sites — in those cases 'address' serves as the primary text identifier.
'price' is a structured object (not a raw string). Use {amount, currency_code, currency_symbol, period}.
'floor_area' preserves the original unit (m2 or ft2) — do not auto-convert.
Use 'address' for location information on listing cards; 'location' from the old schema is replaced by 'address'.
